headerDisplay: Connect your GE / Interlogix Concord 4 alarm panel to HomeKit via the SuperBus 2000 RS-232 Automation Module.

serialPort.title: Serial Port Path
serialPort.description: Path to the RS-232 serial device (e.g., /dev/ttyUSB0 or /dev/tty.usbserial-xxxx).

baudRate.title: Baud Rate
baudRate.description: SuperBus 2000 RS-232 modules operate at 9600 baud (8 data bits, Odd parity, 1 stop bit).

tcpHost.title: TCP Host / IP Address
tcpHost.description: Hostname or IP address of the serial-to-IP bridge (e.g., ser2net).

tcpPort.title: TCP Port
tcpPort.description: TCP port of the serial-to-IP bridge.

pinCode.title: User / Master PIN Code (Optional)
pinCode.description: Optional 4-digit PIN code. If provided and 'Use PIN for Disarm/Arm' is enabled, keypress sequences use this PIN instead of virtual keyfob commands.

usePinForArming.title: Use PIN Code Instead of Keyfob Commands
usePinForArming.description: When false (default), the plugin uses Concord's direct Keyfob Arm/Disarm commands (0x20, 0x27, 0x28). Enable if your panel requires a PIN sequence for disarming.

autoDiscoverZones.title: Auto-Discover Zones
autoDiscoverZones.description: Automatically expose panel zones and infer their HomeKit sensor type from the panel's zone group and name.

debugProtocol.title: Log Raw RS-232 Frames (Debug)
debugProtocol.description: Log raw hex frames sent and received over the RS-232 interface.
